name: Ultimate Performance Power Plan
description: Activates the hidden Ultimate Performance power plan. Maximizes CPU performance by eliminating micro-latencies in power state transitions. Ideal for desktop gaming and workstation use.

name: High Performance Power Plan
description: Activates the built-in High Performance power plan. Keeps CPU at higher clock speeds and reduces latency from power state transitions.

name: Core Parking - Max Performance
description: Sets minimum processor cores to 100%, preventing CPU core parking. All cores stay active for maximum gaming and workload performance. Requires a CPU that exposes the 'PROCCORES' processor power setting. This setting is optional in the processor subgroup and is hidden on many CPUs — on those machines the command is rejected with 'Invalid Parameters' and there is nothing to change.

params.detectCommand: $out = & powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR PROCCORES; $row = $out | Select-String 'Current AC Power Setting Index:'; if (-not $row) { throw 'PROCCORES reported no AC index' }; [Convert]::ToInt64((($row -split '0x')[1]), 16)
params.applyCommand: powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR PROCCORES 100; powercfg /setdcvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR PROCCORES 100; powercfg /setactive SCHEME_CURRENT
params.rollbackCommand: powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR PROCCORES 0; powercfg /setdcvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR PROCCORES 0; powercfg /setactive SCHEME_CURRENT

detect.command: $out = & powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR PROCCORES; $row = $out | Select-String 'Current AC Power Setting Index:'; if (-not $row) { throw 'PROCCORES reported no AC index' }; [Convert]::ToInt64((($row -split '0x')[1]), 16)

apply.command: powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR PROCCORES 100; powercfg /setdcvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR PROCCORES 100; powercfg /setactive SCHEME_CURRENT

rollback.command: powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR PROCCORES 0; powercfg /setdcvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR PROCCORES 0; powercfg /setactive SCHEME_CURRENT

verify.command: $out = & powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR PROCCORES; $row = $out | Select-String 'Current AC Power Setting Index:'; if (-not $row) { throw 'PROCCORES reported no AC index' }; [Convert]::ToInt64((($row -split '0x')[1]), 16)
